verdict.rationale: The firm's strategic transactions and licensing page names "Open source software compliance" and "Commercializing open source software" as types of strategic counsel, which is a named first-party capability. It is only a bullet-level mention, and OSS usage policies for product companies are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit OSS usage-policy counseling, any detail on how compliance work is done (license audits, inbound/outbound review), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability

citations.quote: Commercializing open source software and related business models ... Open source software compliance
With the largest team in the world focused on licensing, strategic partnering, commercial transactions, and data privacy for emerging company/venture capital (EC/VC) companies and funds
